answer: To resist sybil attacks each agent must harbor a private sequential proof state that grows like a glacier of prior epochs memory-hard challenges. The state is non-transferable and exclusive: sharing it across clones fails verification because the saffron canary a unique random seed injected per identity must match the live working set. An attacker spawning n fakes pays linear memory and sequential compute per identity with no pooling since the glacier cannot be forked cheaply and correlated saffron mismatches trigger joint slash of the entire harbor.
